title: Bitpanda moves from Premium Partner to the back of the shirt
text: Eighteen months after becoming Premium Partner and Official Crypto Trading Partner, Bitpanda expanded its deal to become AC Milan's Back-of-Shirt sponsor from the February 2025 Derby against Inter, joining the club's Principal Partners. Rated 'none': the brand belongs to privately held Bitpanda Group AG (founded in Vienna, 2014), whose owners are the three founders and venture investors, with no state stake or human-rights record found.

source.name: AC Milan, 'AC MILAN AND BITPANDA EXPAND PARTNERSHIP WITH NEW BACK OF SHIRT SPONSORSHIP'
source.quote: Starting from today, Bitpanda will serve as the new Back-of-Shirt sponsor for the men's First Team , joining AC Milan's family of Principal Partners .
